purpose: Compare three materially different visual systems before any production UI implementation is authorized.
businessQuestions: Can the operator understand current operating status within 10 seconds?
Can the operator identify the most important gap within 30 seconds?
Can the operator distinguish business performance from data health?
Which visual language should become the Airburg SaaS identity?

evidenceBoundary.note: All values exist only to make layout and hierarchy comparable. They cannot be used for business conclusions.

directions.name: 清透经营中枢
directions.thesis: 用空气感、仪器感和清晰的优先级，让经营者先看结果与效率，再读完整经营台账。
directions.bestFor: 希望摆脱通用后台感，并愿意明确经营指标优先级的产品方向。
directions.desktop: Airy 248px navigation concept, four priority metrics, trend before the remaining grouped ledger.
directions.mobile: Two-column priority block followed by the trend and a complete two-column grouped ledger.

tokenProposal.shape: soft circular brand mark, restrained rounded filters, thin neutral grid

directions.compatibilityReason: The existing textual visual reference treats the 17 KPI as an equal 6+6+5 matrix. Direction A preserves every metric but introduces a four-metric visual priority and new business groupings.
risks: Can drift into a generic teal SaaS look if brand detail is weak.
Priority treatment could be mistaken for a formula or governance priority unless explicitly documented.
Excess whitespace could hide the full operating ledger below the fold.

directions.name: 精密仪表盘
directions.thesis: 以高密度但不微型化的 17 指标矩阵，服务高频扫读、对比和日常经营操作。
directions.bestFor: 希望最低契约风险、最高信息效率，并沿用当前 6+6+5 信息骨架的方向。
directions.desktop: 224px precision navigation, 64px command bar, compact 17-cell matrix, series row, then trend.
directions.mobile: Complete two-column KPI ledger with compact navigation and no hidden metrics.

tokenProposal.shape: low-radius controls, strong tabular alignment, precise structural rules

directions.compatibilityReason: It keeps the existing 17-metric order and 6+6+5 hierarchy without introducing a new metric priority claim.
risks: Precision can degrade into spreadsheet or monitoring-wall aesthetics.
Too much blue or too many rules would make the page visually tiring.
Density must never be achieved with tiny text.

directions.name: 经营编辑台
directions.thesis: 把首页做成连续的经营阅读工作面，用排版节奏、编号与章节关系替代后台卡片堆叠。
directions.bestFor: 希望形成更鲜明、更成熟的品牌编辑感，同时保留完整台账的方向。

informationArchitecture.trendAndHealth: 9/12 trend plus 3/12 data-health note on desktop

directions.desktop: 192px low-chrome navigation, numbered metric ledger, editorial spacing, trend with a side data-health note.
directions.mobile: Complete two-column numbered ledger; chapter rhythm replaces card stacking.

tokenProposal.shape: 4px radii, numbered cells, typographic hierarchy, minimal chrome

directions.compatibilityReason: It preserves the current metric order and count but changes the product shell, spacing rhythm, and visual voice substantially.
risks: Can look like a report, newspaper, or spreadsheet if hierarchy is not interactive enough.
Warm neutral surfaces may conflict with the final Airburg product palette.
Editorial styling must not weaken operational scan speed.
